name: openapi-postman-test-generator
description: Generate Postman collections and API tests from Swagger/OpenAPI specs

scripts.test:smoke: node test/smoke.js && node test/advanced.js && node test/regression.js && node test/workflow.js && node test/ai-providers.js && node test/windows-command.js && node test/diff.js && node test/exporters.js && node test/tags-coverage-oauth.js && node test/response-headers.js && node test/run-coverage.js && node test/examples.js
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e.js && node test/e2e-workflow.js && node test/e2e-oauth.js && node test/e2e-headers.js && node test/e2e-run-coverage.js && node test/runner-windows.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:package && npm audit --omit=dev
scripts.diagrams: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@latest -i docs/diagrams/overview.mmd -c docs/diagrams/mermaid.config.json -b transparent -t default -o docs/diagrams/overview-light.svg && npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@latest -i docs/diagrams/overview.mmd -c docs/diagrams/mermaid.config.json -b transparent -t dark -o docs/diagrams/overview-dark.svg
